name: Assess Ability
body:
School divination; Level inquisitor 1, sorcerer/wizard 2*
Components V, S, M (an ink-filled quill)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. plus 5 ft. / 2 levels)
Target 1 creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This divination spell reveals the ability scores and class levels (if any) or hit dice of the chosen target, including archetype choices, feats, and skill bonuses possessed.

*A rogue with the major magic rogue talent can cast this spell as if it were a 1st level spell.
